description:
FILED s540e (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15) while building #4988.  Probe scratch/s540e/probe/md5layer.pl in the s540e worktree (a file "caf\xc3\xa9
line2
\xe2\x98\xba
"): perl '<' and '<:raw' 536f50af..., '<:crlf' 1b6e1921..., '<:utf8' and '<:encoding(UTF-8)' 536f50af... (the raw bytes: PerlIO_read below the decoding).  PCL (base and tree alike): '<:crlf' 536f50af..., '<:utf8' / '<:encoding(UTF-8)' die.  The shim's addfile is `read($fh, $buf, 65536)` -- a character read.  perl's XS reads with PerlIO_read, which for :utf8 hands over the encoded octets and for :crlf the translated ones.

BAR: probe perl -> base -> tree; a row in Pl/t/digest-shim-01.t.  The :crlf half may be PCL's read() and :crlf (probe `read` alone first).
subject: PRE-EXISTING (s540e, probed): Digest::MD5->addfile on a handle with a layer hashes the DECODED characters under PCL -- :utf8 / :encoding(UTF-8) die "Wide character in subroutine entry" where perl's XS hashes the file's bytes, and :crlf gives the untranslated digest where perl hashes the CRLF-translated text
